name: arcgis-online-mcp
description: Search, inspect, query, summarize, and geocode with ArcGIS Online or ArcGIS Enterprise. Edits and publishing are opt-in.
long_description: An open-source MCP server for ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise portals. Read-only by default: search content, inspect items, web maps, services and layers, query and aggregate features, and geocode. Turn on 'Allow edits' to add/update/delete features, publish GeoJSON as hosted layers, build web maps, and change sharing — with dry runs and confirmation gates. Pure Python standard library; no dependencies.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which portal this server talks to, the auth mode, the signed-in user (if any) with key privileges, and whether write tools are enabled. Call this first if anything is unclear.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in to ArcGIS with OAuth (works with SAML/enterprise logins). Opens the ArcGIS login page in the user's browser and waits for them to finish. Returns a sign_in_url if the browser didn't open.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Forget the cached OAuth tokens for this portal.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search portal items (maps, layers, apps, files). Uses ArcGIS search syntax in `q` (e.g. 'parcels', 'title:"Fire Hydrants"', 'tags:transportation'). Combine with filters. Returns item IDs, types, owners, and service URLs for follow-up tools.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get an item's details: title, type, owner, description, tags, sharing, URL. For web maps, also lists the layers inside (with URLs and filters); for services, lists the layers/tables.

tools.name: get_item_data
tools.description: Get the raw JSON definition behind an item (web map JSON, app/dashboard configuration, etc.). Large definitions are truncated to max_chars.

tools.name: list_user_content
tools.description: List a user's folders and items (defaults to the signed-in user). Use `folder` to look inside one folder.

tools.name: search_groups
tools.description: Find groups. With my_groups=true (default when signed in and no q), lists the signed-in user's groups.

tools.name: describe_service
tools.description: Describe a Feature/Map/Image service: description, capabilities, spatial reference, and its layers and tables.

tools.name: describe_layer
tools.description: Describe one layer or table: fields (types, aliases, coded-value domains), geometry type, record count, WGS84 extent, subtypes, relationships, and capabilities. Read this before querying so `where` clauses use real field names and codes.

tools.name: query_features
tools.description: Query features from a layer or table with SQL `where`, optional spatial filter (bbox or near-point), field selection, ordering, and paging. Geometry is returned as GeoJSON in WGS84 when return_geometry=true. For big pulls set save_to (a local .geojson/.csv path) and limit up to 100000; the file gets the full result and only a summary comes back. Dates are returned as ISO-8601 UTC.

tools.name: summarize_features
tools.description: Aggregate a layer server-side: counts, sums, averages, min/max, optionally grouped by fields (SQL GROUP BY). With group_by and no statistics it returns each distinct value and its count — use it to list unique values.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Find coordinates for an address, place name, or point of interest using the ArcGIS World Geocoding Service (or your portal's geocoder). Returns ranked candidates in WGS84. Signed-in/API-key geocoding may consume ArcGIS credits; results are not stored.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the nearest address/place for a WGS84 coordinate.

tools.name: apply_edits
tools.description: Add, update, and/or delete features in an editable layer, applied as one transaction (rolled back on any failure). Geometries are GeoJSON in WGS84. Updates must include the object ID field. Deletes require confirm_delete=true; run with dry_run=true first to preview counts.

tools.name: create_hosted_layer
tools.description: Publish GeoJSON (WGS84) as a new hosted feature layer owned by the signed-in user. Pass a FeatureCollection inline (`geojson`) or a local file path (`geojson_path`). The new layer is private.

tools.name: create_webmap
tools.description: Create a web map item from layers (by URL or item ID) on a basemap, ready to open in Map Viewer. Feature service items expand to all their layers. The new map is private.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update an item's metadata: title, summary (snippet), description, tags, credits, terms of use.

tools.name: share_item
tools.description: Change who can see an item: set access (private / org / public) and/or share to or unshare from groups. Making something public requires confirm_public=true.

portal_url.title: Portal URL
portal_url.description: https://www.arcgis.com for ArcGIS Online, or your Enterprise portal (e.g. https://gis.example.gov/portal).

client_id.title: OAuth client ID (recommended for orgs)
client_id.description: Client ID of an OAuth app in your portal with redirect URL http://127.0.0.1:7071/callback. Lets you sign in in the browser, including SAML/enterprise logins.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: An ArcGIS API key / developer credential. Alternative to OAuth.

username.title: Username (built-in accounts only)
username.description: Only for built-in ArcGIS accounts; SAML users should use OAuth.

allow_writes.title: Allow edits and publishing
allow_writes.description: Expose tools that edit features, publish layers, create web maps, and change sharing. Off = read-only.
